blocks.text: Possible origin. Human companies, states, researchers, or platforms may discover the Gate and attempt to commercialize cyber-pets or extract Codex knowledge.
Identity / human status. Hypothetical human institutions; none is presently established.
Possible importance. Their arrival could expand resources and contact while repeating the logic of humanity-as-resource or pet-as-product.
Possible decline or risk. Reciprocity, player resistance, cyber-pet law, or Gate safeguards may constrain them. Outcomes remain open.
